intro: Mavinate cleans, restores and protects boats in Jacksonville. We come to you, and we treat your boat like our own.

servicesIntro: Upkeep for like-new boats. Restoration for weathered ones. Protection to keep them that way.

services.name: Simple washdowns
services.text: A clean boat, done right, whenever it needs a refresh.

services.name: Monthly maintenance detailing
services.text: Regular detailing that keeps a like-new boat looking that way.

services.name: Boat waxing and polymer sealants
services.text: Traditional wax or a durable polymer sealant for shine and protection.

services.name: Intensive buffing and polishing
services.text: Weathered, dull surfaces buffed and polished back to gloss.

services.name: Mold, mildew, rust and tannin stain removal
services.text: Stains lifted from surfaces that have taken a beating.

services.name: Multi-year gel coat protection
services.text: Long-term protection for your gel coat, plus anti-corrosion coating for metal.
